methods.name: Reverse
methods.header:
method Reverse(s: seq<int>) returns (r: seq<int>)
  ensures |r| == |s|
  ensures forall k :: 0 <= k < |s| ==> r[k] == s[|s| - 1 - k]

mutants.violation: Fails a fixed postcondition for a permitted input.

representations.natural: [R1] The result sequence r has the same length as s, including when s is empty. [R2] For every valid index k of s, r[k] equals s[length(s) - 1 - k].
